description: Pick the pieces that qualify as samples (listed at $20 or under, under 7 inches overall, not a made-to-order line) from a plan or from given variant ids, and return a cart link with one of each plus the sample terms. Samples are bought at the normal price and the shopper keeps them. Samples are credited only on a qualifying order (20 or more of the same item); the returned sample terms give the policy link. Never promise a credit on a smaller order. Pieces that do not qualify are returned with the reason.
